label: Height
description: Overall human stature from very short to towering, independent of body build.
notes: Overall stature belongs here; body frame, muscularity and relative limb or torso proportions belong in person.build. Values are short adjective phrases, with medium-height shown as average height in the chooser so every value fits the frame a ___ person. Very tall is markedly above surrounding people, while towering is an exaggerated scale contrast best shown beside other people or familiar objects.
